sourceFile: 63.1. TIU L5S3-01 LR REPORT DATA SPL - 2026.01.20_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable STD, R LINE, and L LINE context but the changed factor and outcome grouping are not reliable.
issues: Changed factor is the filename, not the evidenced STD vs R LINE vs L LINE comparison.
Baseline and test conditions are marked unclear despite source rows identifying STD and line samples.
Outcome metrics mix headers, specs, frequencies, and data values as conditions.
Several subresults appear transposed or misgrouped and cannot support final conclusions.
Review title and purpose are not meaningful for the validation report.
requiredUserQuestions: Should R LINE and L LINE be treated as separate test conditions against STD?
correctionPlan: Set primary changed factor to STD reference versus R LINE and L LINE sample lines.
Use RAW DATA sample-name rows and GRAPH summary rows as changed-condition evidence.
Separate SPL, Fo, and THD outcomes using report headers and spec rows.
Remove transposed numeric-condition subresults unless regrouped by true frequency and sample columns.
Rewrite title and purpose to reflect TIU L5S3-01 LR SPL validation.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but cited rows are not sufficient until grouping is corrected.
